# CLADORA — Operating Platform for the Built World

> CLADORA is the unified operating platform for properties, spaces, and physical assets. Built on persistent property identity, decoupled workspace boundaries, scoped authority, and connected operational domains.

## Core Architecture & Documentation

- [CLADORA Platform Overview (English)](https://cladora.ro/en/platform): Decoupled 4-tier architecture, workspace boundaries, and connected operational domains.
- [CLADORA Platform Overview (Română)](https://cladora.ro/ro/platform): Prezentare generală a platformei și contexte de lucru.
- [System Architecture](https://cladora.ro/en/platform/architecture): 4-tier decoupled model (Asset, Workspace, Authority, Domain) and canonical provider boundaries (CORE, DOCUMENTS, FIN01, BK01, OPERATIONS, COMMUNICATIONS, AUDIT).
- [Property Lifecycle](https://cladora.ro/en/platform/lifecycle): Provenance continuity across 10 non-linear asset lifecycle phases from definition to succession.
- [Trust & Governance](https://cladora.ro/en/platform/trust): Workspace isolation, mandate-based authority, AAL2 authentication, and additive audit logs.
- [Capabilities Architecture](https://cladora.ro/en/capabilities): Governed enterprise capability framework across 14 capability families.
- [Industries Architecture](https://cladora.ro/en/industries): Composition of platform capabilities across residential, commercial, logistics, mixed-use, and institutional assets.
- [Community & Experience](https://cladora.ro/en/community-experience): Experience composition layer for people, places, services, events, guides, and authorized interactions.
- [CLADORA Intelligence](https://cladora.ro/en/ai): Governed, subordinate operational intelligence operating strictly within workspace authority and policy review.
- [Solutions Architecture](https://cladora.ro/en/solutions): Tailored solutions for builders, owners, homeowner associations, property managers, tenants, and service providers.
- [Scope & Partnership Pricing](https://cladora.ro/en/pricing): Scope-based and partnership engagement framework aligned with organizational governance and asset scale.
- [Partnership & Contact](https://cladora.ro/en/contact): Direct architectural consultation and onboarding assessment.

## Architecture Specifications
- **Master Architecture Standard**: Decoupled 4-tier model (Asset, Workspace, Authority, Connected Domains).
- **Canonical Providers**: Single-responsibility authority for identity, documents, financial ledgers, booking capacity, operations dispatch, and communications.
- **Authority Model**: 5D dynamic tuple `Person–Property–Role–Time–Purpose` enforced by zero-write denial and additive audit logging.
- **Language Support**: First-class parity across Romanian (RO), English (EN), and Persian (FA).
